name: Gaussian Preprocessing
definition: A CUDA kernel that preprocesses 3D Gaussian parameters (means, scales, rotations, opacities, covariances) into voxel-space coordinates, conic matrices, and radii for efficient rasterization.
summary: Gaussian Preprocessing is a CUDA kernel that transforms 3D Gaussian parameters into voxel-space coordinates and conic matrices for efficient tile-based rasterization, distinct by operating on pre-computed covariances rather than frustum approximation.
